steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.body: Mix in a bowl: **4 cups flour**, **2 cups sugar**, **6 tsp baking powder**, **1 tsp salt**, **4 eggs**, **2 cups plain yogurt**, **1 cup vegetable oil**, **2 tsp lemon zest**, **¼ cup lemon juice** and **2 cups unsweetened berries**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Place in greased muffin tins ⅔ full and bake at 350°F for about 15 minutes, or until the center springs back when tested.
